rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: forms (a), (b), and (c) — the evaluated FSBS harness fixes four rounds of force-sampling, reward-model scoring, top-k selection, and continued sampling; after each round, code selects the highest-scoring completions and forces the next highlight, then deterministically chooses the final critique by maximizing rm_score + LENGTH_MODIFIER * num_highlights. The policy and reward models perform bounded generation and scoring tasks, while code controls the outer sequence and the consequences of their outputs.
